caption: Because not continuing to live the cycle that was taught to you from birth in a world that makes it seem normal is a feat that doesn’t get near enough recognition and praise. 🤸🏼‍♀️❤️‍🔥🙌🏻

hook.text: TO EVERY WOMAN WHO HAD TO UNLEARN LOVE THAT FELT LIKE SURVIVING,
hook.template: To every woman who [HARD THING SHE GOT THROUGH]... I'm so proud of you
hook.whyItWorks: It calls out a specific, painful experience and the viewer who lived it feels seen in one line. Pairing that text with blurry party footage creates a mismatch you have to watch to resolve, and the list structure promises a payoff line at the end.

format.visualLayout: Three handheld scenes (party, gym, kitchen), centred white caps text on each, trending song underneath, no voice
format.pacing: slow, 4 scenes of about 5s each, one text line per scene
format.reasoning: Text-over-footage lets the lines land without a voice, and the setting change from a party to the gym to a calm kitchen tells the before-and-after story visually. The caption is the thesis, so the video can stay simple.

angle.topic: Women's self-worth and leaving unhealthy patterns
angle.angle: Celebrating the inner change behind a fitness journey
angle.commonBelief: A fitness transformation is mostly about how your body looks
angle.contrarianTake: The bigger transformation is choosing yourself and breaking the pattern you grew up with

myVersion.script:
On-screen text, one line per scene:
To every woman who served everyone else first and ate whatever was left,
to every woman who picked up her first dumbbell after 30 and didn't care who was watching,
to every woman who heard 'you've gained weight' at a family function and still showed up for herself the next morning,
I see you. And I'm proud of you.
